The conventions we use in this chapter are the same as those in the
chapter on algebraic spaces. For convenience we repeat them here.

<STRUCT_0002><STRUCT_0003>

as in Topologies, Definition <REF_0001>.

of <MATH_0002>. We discuss what changes if you change the big
fppf site in
Section <REF_0002>.

<STRUCT_0008><STRUCT_0009>
Note that any fpqc covering is a universal effective
epimorphism, see
Descent, Lemma <REF_0004>.
Hence the topology on <MATH_0013>
